comment: Asset keys the shim pre-loads through __crcbl_web_fetch_* before the demo boots. sundial has none: the plaza is described in Rust rather than loaded, it draws no sprite art at all — sample rule 11 exempts it by name, and flat untextured surfaces are the point, because texture detail is what hides a shadow artefact — and its shaders and font atlas are compiled into the wasm module. The list is the seam, not the content.
